values.en: Second Partial Derivatives of a Surface

Let $\Omega\subseteq\mathbb R^2$ be Euclidean open and $X:\mathbb R^2\to\mathbb R^3$ be smooth and regular on $\Omega$. At $q\in\Omega$, put $U=X_u(q)$ and $V=X_v(q)$; these form a basis of $T_qX$. For $i,j\in\{1,2\}$, define $X_{ij}(q)=\partial_j(\partial_i X)(q)$. Here indices 1 and 2 denote $u$ and $v$. The derivative is taken on coordinate lines in an open neighbourhood of $q$ contained in $\Omega$; values or derivatives outside $\Omega$ do not enter. Thus $X_{11}=X_{uu}$, $X_{12}=X_{uv}$ and $X_{22}=X_{vv}$.
values.zh-CN: 设 $\Omega\subseteq\mathbb R^2$ 为欧氏开集，$X:\mathbb R^2\to\mathbb R^3$ 在 $\Omega$ 上光滑且正则。取 $q\in\Omega$，记 $U=X_u(q)$、$V=X_v(q)$，它们构成 $T_qX$ 的一组基。对 $i,j\in\{1,2\}$，定义 $X_{ij}(q)=\partial_j(\partial_i X)(q)$，指标 1、2 分别表示 $u,v$。在 $q$ 的开邻域内沿坐标直线求导，该邻域包含于 $\Omega$；不使用 $\Omega$ 外的导数或取值。因此 $X_{11}=X_{uu}$、$X_{12}=X_{uv}$、$X_{22}=X_{vv}$。
